notes.note: Rows 0721 #0.43-57 are a 15-way party-leader block (MessWinSet 42+k). Pt_Chara_Check order in 0721.bla: Zero, Ultraman, Mebius, Seven, Taro, OOO, Rider 1, Shotaro, Black RX, Momotaros, 00, Nu, Wing Zero, Zeta, God. So #0.48 OOO, #0.49 Rider 1, #0.50 Shotaro, #0.51 RX, #0.52 Momotaros, #0.53-57 the Gundams. Identical Japanese kept identical. The leading 'iya' brushes off Ankh's worry (#0.42: the kaiju have grown stronger); rendered 'No...'. Subject 'we' restored.
Speaker Ultraman Belial confirmed (CHARA_NAME 141). 'Never see me again' implies they won't survive; kept literal.
Bracketed sound effect: caps in double quotes per style.

Party block MessWinSet 62+k, same leader order as above: #0.65 = Mebius (polite form), #0.72 = Momotaros (rough form) - both match, confirming the order. Played only if flag 2730 is set (party saw the door earlier).
Slice has no speaker. Script: else-branch of the flag 2730 check, shown while Ankh's name (CHARA_NAME 36) is still up, so the speaker is Ankh, not narration.
Narration; separate later event at the closed door. #0.84 Ankh confirmed.

Event 0724: #0.1 Ankh; #0.2-16, #0.18-32, #0.34-48 are party blocks with leader order Seven, Mebius, Zero, Taro, Ultraman, Black RX, Momotaros, Shotaro, OOO, Rider 1, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00, Nu (from 0724.bla). #0.17 and #0.33 King Pandon (CHARA_NAME 170).
King Pandon cry; #0.33 uses the established 'Kih!! Kih!! Kiiiiiiih!!' from the glossary.

'Yahari' = 'just as I thought': Belial warned the kaiju had grown stronger; they fought King Pandon before (MainEventMess0511). #0.40 Momotaros and #0.41 Shotaro wordings match the leader order. #0.34 and #0.38 differ only in a small vs. full kana in the grunt, so slightly different grunts.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0721.bla and 0724.bla; extractor labels correct except 0721 #0.80 (unlabelled; it is Ankh). No new names or terms.
